title: Lots of interactions last night - were any you?
content: Just curious if any of these experiences ring a bell for anyone… - Mixed race man, very tall, sat with me at a music festival that took place inside the mall. If this was you, what artist was performing? - Birthday girl with black hair who was interviewing me for a job at a clothing store. Which drink did you suggest I order when we went out to celebrate your birthday after? You laughed at my pronunciation of it. - Female worker at the ride on the pier… you pointed out something you noticed about one of my body parts out of some sort of medical concern. Worth a shot lol. Not used to so many interactions with people who I don’t know in real life. Also visited a bookstore at the basement of a train station last night. Very dark place, single old man employee. Has anyone been there? The books seemed weird and unreadable. What stood out to me was I told him “I have always wanted to check this place out, but am never in the area.” Makes me think this is a common place.
